topic: How would the 0.25 dB passband loss affect link budget margins in low-noise satellite receiver frontends?
consensus_response: The 0.25 dB passband loss reduces link budget margins by increasing noise temperature and decreasing signal-to-noise ratio, compromising system reliability and availability. This loss affects low-margin links significantly, consuming a larger portion of available margin and potentially leading to outages or performance degradation.
reference_context: SatCom systems rely on link budget equations, considering parameters like antenna gain, noise temperature, and power constraints to ensure reliable transmission.
